name: funding_scan
description: Rank current funding with estimated net APY for a hold period. Returns the full ranked result plus executable/anywhere views, failures, unmatched and hidden-thin counts. Annualization is simple, not compounded. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, or holds keys.

sizeUsd.description: Positive USD size. Defaults to default_size_usd config or 1000.

market.description: Normalized base ticker; omit to scan all markets.

venues.description: Venue IDs: hl, lighter, lighter-mainnet, aster, binance, bybit, okx. Omit for all.

topExec.description: Positive integer limit for executable view; default 5.

top.description: Positive integer limit for anywhere view, or executable-only view; default 10.

allPairs.description: Include every pair instead of the best per base in each view.

executable.description: Only the executable view, limited by top.

minApy.description: Minimum gross simple annualized spread percentage; not the net APY filter.

minVolume24hUsd.description: Nonnegative minimum known USD volume per leg; default 1000000.

includeThin.description: Include below-threshold or unknown-volume pairs in the views.

holdDays.description: Positive hold horizon in days for fee amortization; default 7.

name: funding_rates
description: Read current native-market funding observations with hourly and simple annualized rates and snapshot metadata. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, or holds keys.

venue.description: Venue ID; omit for all venues.

market.description: Normalized base ticker; omit for all markets.

name: funding_history
description: Read settled keyless funding history, interval-weighted averages, coverage, and the best average spread. Lighter has no keyless history. Annualization is simple, not compounded. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, or holds keys.

base.description: Required normalized base ticker, for example BTC or PEPE.

venues.description: Venue IDs: hl, lighter, lighter-mainnet, aster, binance, bybit, okx. Omit for all.

name: explain
description: Read bundled Markdown about funding, basis, fees, and Mobius protection. Omit topic to list topics. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, or holds keys.

topic.description: Bundled topic name, such as funding, annualization, or liquidation-protection.

simple.description: Return the plain-language Simple section only.

name: task_list
description: Read public tasks for an owner. Funding accrued is an estimate. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, or holds keys.

owner.description: Public 20-byte 0x owner address. Defaults to the owner config key.

name: task_get
description: Read one public task and optional trim/resize logs. Funding accrued is an estimate. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, or holds keys.

owner.description: Public 20-byte 0x owner address. Defaults to the owner config key.

name: config_get
description: Read a local setting: api_base, owner, default_size_usd, taker_fee_bps.<venue>, or builder_fee_tenths_bps. No setting is changed. Read-only. This tool never signs, trades, or holds keys.
